purpose: Source-linked coaching topics; no automated correctness targets

sources.title: Ground Up 3.0 curriculum outline
sources.scope: Public course description and topic outline only; paid lesson content has not been reviewed

sources.title: Interview with basketball shooting coach Mike Dunn (transcript)
sources.scope: Public interview statements attributed to Mike Dunn

rules.title: Preparation and posture
rules.source_backed_principle: Preparation, posture, and how the ball is held before shooting are coaching topics.
rules.available_evidence: set-phase joint angles and torso lean
rules.required_to_judge: Time-resolved posture, ball placement relative to body, camera perspective, verified landmarks.
rules.review_prompt: Review each set-phase frame for preparation and ball position; do not correct posture from one 2D angle alone.

rules.title: Connection and sequencing
rules.source_backed_principle: The curriculum explicitly covers connection, sequencing, and creation of power.
rules.required_to_judge: Time-aligned leg, arm, and ball motion, validated tracking across frames.
rules.review_prompt: Compare the motion leading into each release frame; release angles alone cannot determine sequencing.

rules.title: Balance and body control
rules.source_backed_principle: The curriculum and public interview discuss balance and posture.
rules.required_to_judge: Camera-calibrated, multi-frame body stability and reliable floor/foot information.
rules.review_prompt: Inspect multi-frame balance and landings; a single 2D offset is not a balance grade.

rules.title: Guide-hand mechanics
rules.source_backed_principle: The curriculum includes the guide hand; Dunn's interview discusses shooting-hand position and guide-hand involvement.
rules.available_evidence: no reliable guide-hand contact or finger-action metric
rules.required_to_judge: Close-up hand and ball evidence covering the release, preferably a suitable camera view.
rules.review_prompt: Obtain clearer hand and ball footage before assessing guide-hand involvement.

restrictions: No target joint angles are specified or inferred.
A large observed difference does not establish incorrect mechanics.
No specific corrective drill is prescribed without verified video evidence.
Current phase-summary metrics do not establish ball-hand contact, fine wrist action, or movement sequencing.
The tool is independent and is not endorsed by SeeMikeDunn.
